source_hash_convention: server_metadata.source_sha256 hashes actual archived/executed bytes (CRLF preserved); normalized_source_sha256 hashes CRLF to LF for local source comparison; raw logs/reports use actual bytes

preparation.method: Reuse A01-84 UTVideo after fresh original/derived full-frame equality check; no new conversion

limitations: Development only; unchanged config/window/threshold/GT/matching. No evaluation videos/truth used.
Delivery PASS verifies payload/EOF/freshness; full_sampling_pass separately requires every expected 500ms sample. No skipped frames hidden.
Smoke0009 uses explicitly verified historical UTVideo derived input. Other six clips use original bytes. No derived log paired with original-hash GT or new server TP/FP/FN claim.

CPU timings: one sequential offline pass, four torch threads, process nice10; includes predict pre/postprocess, excludes load/decode/pacing/API. Windows comparison is different hardware/OS/input preparation, not isolated causal benchmarking.
Two short seven-video trials plus offline probes; not sustained/multicamera/CPU-credit/network/WFI/production validation.
Original full logs retained locally; model/video assets and server access details excluded from Git. Default model unchanged; final license/target/independent evaluation remain pending.
